about: Defaults of mod-specific recipe load-condition flags, cited from each mod's source at the pinned version (docs/decisions.md, 2026-10-13). Keyed by mod id, the exact version its metadata declares, and condition type. A flag that is not here, or a mod version that is not here, is an unknown load condition: residue, never a guess. A flag's config_key, where present, is the option's name in the mod's own config file at the cited line, accepted as an alias by `portkit convert --config`. An entry's registers lists ids the mod's code registers only while that flag is on, with a citation; the item converter leaves them out when the flag is off. The values list holds the mod's non-boolean config options a converter reads (not load conditions), each with its type, cited default and the range the mod's config accepts; `portkit convert --config <mod>.<key>=<number>` replaces the default, and a value outside the range is an error. An entry with code_gate names the class whose no-argument boolean methods its flags are when the mod's code tests them (a config wrapper's adamantite()), keyed by method name; portkit.biomecode decides Fabric code-attached ores with them (#281).
